#!/bin/sh
# POSIX shell function: prints the mean of the 3rd column of a TSV file.
# Rows whose 3rd field is not numeric are skipped.

mean() {
    # Accumulate the sum and count of numeric values in column 3.
    sum=0
    count=0

    # Read the input line by line.
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Extract the third field (tab-separated).
        field=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -f3)

        # Check if the field is numeric (integer or decimal).
        if printf '%s' "$field" | grep -qE '^-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*$'; then
            sum=$(printf '%s' "$sum" | awk '{print $1 + $2}')
            count=$((count + 1))
        fi
    done

    # Compute and print the mean.
    if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
        printf '%s' "$sum" | awk '{printf "%.6f\n", $1 / $2}'
    fi
}
